clue.text: Somewhere in Africa

parts.note: a bare geographical pointer to one of the countries of the continent, here a landlocked state in the south-east

explanation.surface: A vague gesture at a place on the African map.
explanation.definitionFit: The country is a landlocked republic in southern central Africa, beside Lake Nyasa.

clue.text: Constructed a strong box reinforced for security?

parts.note: constructed means made, past tense of building
a safe is a strong box for valuables

explanation.surface: A strongbox built with extra reinforcement to keep its contents secure.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure something is to protect it, as reinforcement does for a vault.

clue.text: Sole member blamed on being different

indicators.note: the letters of the two words take a different arrangement

explanation.surface: The only member of a group gets blamed for not fitting in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sole' reads as 'only' but is the flatfish; the anagram signal 'being different' rearranges BLAMED ON.
explanation.definitionFit: This flatfish is one species of the flounder family, sold in Britain alongside sole.

clue.text: Tiny monarch for a short period

parts.note: wee is Scottish for tiny
K is the abbreviation for king, as in chess notation

explanation.surface: A diminutive ruler reigns only briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: Seven days is a fairly short span of time.

clue.text: Time of need usually accompanied by depression.

definitions.text: Time of need usually accompanied by depression.

parts.words: Time of need usually accompanied by depression.
parts.note: a period of hardship you save for, read also as weather brought on by a low-pressure system

explanation.surface: Hard times tend to bring low spirits with them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Depression' is both gloom and a meteorological low, which brings wet weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Saving for a hard time is putting money aside against bad weather, the idiom for a future emergency.

clue.text: Untimely errors made by chairman's son

indicators.note: made by means the letters are fashioned into something new

parts.note: taken with its S as written

explanation.surface: A company chair's son keeps getting the dates wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' signals an anagram of CHAIRMANS plus SON; the possessive S is a letter here.
explanation.definitionFit: Things placed in the wrong era, like a wristwatch in a Roman film, are chronological mistakes.

clue.text: Greek goddess giving point to a familiar U.S. president

parts.note: N, north, is a compass point
Ike was the familiar name of Dwight Eisenhower

explanation.surface: A goddess lends her emphasis to a well-known American leader.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the winged goddess of victory in Greek myth.

clue.text: That is expensive for a start, beloved

indicators.note: the word for expensive is put at the beginning, before the other piece

parts.note: dear means costly
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: Something costly to begin with turns out cherished.
explanation.definitionFit: A term of endearment for a loved one, like darling.

clue.text: Surrenders investment in comes

definitions.meaning: investment incomes, the returns earned on money invested such as dividends

explanation.surface: Someone gives up their investment income.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving way is ceding ground, and the returns on shares are their dividend rates.

clue.text: … naturally putting this on outdoor activities

definitions.text: … naturally putting this on outdoor activities

parts.words: … naturally putting this on outdoor activities
parts.note: continuing the previous clue, wet weather spoils picnics and games, read as the thing that discourages them

explanation.surface: Wet weather, of course, spoils plans for being outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to 4 across: a wet day puts something on outdoor plans, the idiom for discouraging them, and the answer also means moist.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that dampens enthusiasm is a discouragement, and it is also wetter.

clue.text: Running shorts or long bags won't help in the event

definitions.text: Running shorts or long bags won't help in the event

parts.words: Running shorts or long bags won't help in the event
parts.note: an athletics event where competitors hop inside sacks, so neither sports kit nor baggy trousers helps

explanation.surface: Advice that the right running gear is useless for this particular race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long bags' sounds like loose trousers, but in this race the bag is what you stand in.
explanation.definitionFit: A school sports-day race run with both legs inside a sack.

clue.text: Clearly not out of one's senses

definitions.text: Clearly not out of one's senses

parts.words: Clearly not out of one's senses
parts.note: someone not mad is inside reason; the phrase also means moderately, without excess

explanation.surface: A remark that someone is plainly sane.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means within sensible limits, and taken literally it means inside sanity.

clue.text: Transport from Southend

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Travel out of a seaside town in Essex.
explanation.walkthrough: Southend is a resort on the Thames estuary in Essex; split it and South gives S, end stays as written.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispatch something is to convey it elsewhere, as in sending someone into raptures.

clue.text: Suitable breeze to start a bonfire

definitions.text: Suitable breeze to start a bonfire

parts.words: Suitable breeze to start a bonfire
parts.note: a gentle air current, read as a breeze for kindling a fire

explanation.surface: Advice on the right weather for getting a bonfire going.
explanation.walkthrough: The first word, read as a verb, means set alight, so the gentle breeze is one for kindling.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentle breeze is a slight air current, and ignite is the verb sense of the first word.

clue.text: See 13
Nothing more than a fast time performed slowly

indicators.note: nothing comes after the fast time, added on beyond it

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting
O, the figure zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: Barely more than a quick time, played slowly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' reads as quick, but it is fasting, the forty days of Lent.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning at an unhurried pace.

clue.text: Suitable material for Russian

definitions.meaning: a hard-wearing twilled cloth suits are made from

explanation.surface: Picking cloth fit for a man from Russia.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloth is a twill used in suits and uniforms, and Sergei, or Serge, is a common Russian forename.

clue.text: Fiery character who chucks up his girl-friends?

definitions.text: Fiery character who chucks up his girl-friends?

parts.words: Fiery character who chucks up his girl-friends?
parts.note: old flames are former sweethearts, so someone who throws over his flames is read as a weapon spraying fire

explanation.surface: A hot-tempered man who keeps dumping his girlfriends.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'flame' is a sweetheart, so a man who throws over his flames names the weapon that projects burning fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: The weapon projects a jet of burning fuel; flames are also sweethearts.

clue.text: Uncle's strange moves of chessmen

definitions.meaning: uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker, so his premises
the humblest chess pieces do not jump, so their hopping would be odd

explanation.surface: An uncle makes peculiar moves on the chessboard.
explanation.walkthrough: Pawns never hop in chess, hence 'strange'.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncle is slang for a pawnbroker, so his place is the pledge shop; split, it says pawns hop.

clue.text: Spartan general in Darnley's disguise

indicators.note: in disguise means the letters are dressed up in a new order

parts.note: taken with its S as written

explanation.surface: A commander from Sparta goes about dressed as Lord Darnley.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord Darnley was the husband of Mary, Queen of Scots; his name with its S is the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: He commanded the Spartan fleet that defeated Athens at Aegospotami in the Peloponnesian War.

clue.text: Relaxation after drill suggests strap-hanging isn't so bad

definitions.meaning: the at-ease position soldiers take after parade-ground exercises
read literally, being on your feet on a crowded train is not hard

explanation.surface: A remark that after drill, holding a strap on a crowded train feels fine.
explanation.definitionFit: The parade command lets soldiers relax their posture; literally, staying on one's feet is no hardship.

clue.text: Eavesdropper of low degree

parts.note: something that drips from the eaves at a low temperature, read in the surface as a lowly snoop

explanation.surface: A humble person listening in on others' conversations.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'eavesdropper' as eaves-dropper, and 'low degree' as a cold temperature, not low social rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A frozen spike of water that hangs from the eaves in freezing weather.

clue.text: Room to stretch out

definitions.meaning: a sitting room in a house

explanation.surface: Space enough to lie back.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a living room, and as a verb it means to recline lazily.

clue.text: Cry of a bird about to quarrel

parts.note: C abbreviates circa, about
to row is to argue

explanation.surface: A bird's call is about to start a squabble.
explanation.definitionFit: The sound a cockerel makes at dawn.

clue.text: Bar on 23 for a burglar's tool of trade

definitions.meaning: the answer at 23 across followed by bar names a prising tool
a short iron bar for forcing doors and windows

explanation.surface: The bar a burglar uses in his work.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a short crowbar, the housebreaker's standard means of prising open windows.

clue.text: South American involved with Abel's slayer

indicators.note: involved means turned round, so letters at one end roll to the other

parts.note: in Genesis, Cain killed his brother Abel

explanation.surface: Someone from South America gets mixed up with Cain.
explanation.walkthrough: Move CA from the front of CAIN to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the native people who ruled an empire in the Andes.

clue.text: Above-average light entertainment?

parts.note: a Very light is a signal flare fired from a pistol
a fair is a funfair with rides and stalls

explanation.surface: A better-than-usual bit of easy-going amusement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light entertainment' reads as comedy, but it splits: a Very light is a flare, and a fair is a funfair.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rated well above middling is quite good.

clue.text: See 26
Discuss the opposite view on poetry?

parts.note: con is the argument against, as in pros and cons
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Talk over the contrary opinion on a poem.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer as a noun also means 'the opposite', which feeds the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To talk with someone is to chat or hold a conversation.

clue.text: Was first taken round a tree and whipped

indicators.note: the word for leading is wrapped round the tree

parts.note: led means was in front
the ash is a tree

explanation.surface: Someone tied first round a tree and then flogged.
explanation.definitionFit: Struck with a whip or cane, flogged.

clue.text: Eye opener 26 gives to one and all

parts.note: the opening letter of eye
the first word of the answer at 26 down
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something that opens the eyes is handed out to every person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eye opener' reads as a revelation but gives just the first letter of eye.
explanation.definitionFit: All people together, every single person.

clue.text: Supporter? That's appropriate

definitions.meaning: read as one who props things up

explanation.surface: Is a backer the right person?
explanation.definitionFit: Something fitting is correct, and taken literally the word is one who props up.
